notes.title: Infernal Racket Available Now!
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that Infernal Racket has just gone live! We'd like to thank everyone who made this release possible once more, we couldn't have done it without you. We hope everyone enjoys destroying millions of dollars worth of precious antiques and valuables in the game.

IT'S TIME TO GET SMASHING!

notes.title: Infernal Racket Smashes on to Steam October 20th!
notes.notes:
It's almost time to wreck the place, because [b]Infernal Racket launches on Friday, October 20th, 2017![/b]

Whether you followed the game's development with us on our YouTube channel or this is your first time here, we want to thank you for supporting us.  We hope that you'll find the game to be a fun and supremely satisfying experience!

See you on Friday afternoon!

--Joe and Ed
